title: Existence, uniqueness, stability, and monotonicity of traveling waves for repulsion/attraction chemotaxis models with logistic type source
summary: This paper is devoted to the study of existence, uniqueness, stability, and monotonicity of traveling wave solutions to the following parabolic-elliptic chemotaxis system with logistic type source \begin{equation}\label{E:main-abstract-eq}\tag{CM} \begin{cases} u_t=u_{xx}-χ(u^m v_x)_x +u(1-u^α),\quad &x\in\mathbb{R}\cr 0=v_{xx}-v+u^γ,\quad&x\in\mathbb{R}, \end{cases} \end{equation} where $m,α,γ\ge 1$ and $χ\in\mathbb{R}$.
